title: betray — in terms of…

sentences.sentence: He felt that she had betrayed him.
sentences.translation: 他感觉她背叛了自己。

sentences.sentence: She had betrayed her parents' trust .
sentences.translation: 她辜负了父母对她的信任。

sentences.sentence: I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
sentences.translation: 我永远不会泄露秘密。

translations.translation: （位置或地位）较高的；级别较高的

sentences.sentence: the upper lip
sentences.translation: 上唇

phrases.translation: 特别会员大会；非常股东大会

sentences.sentence: It took an extraordinary amount of work.
sentences.translation: 这费了相当多的功夫。

sentences.sentence: It’s extraordinary that he should make exactly the same mistake again.
sentences.translation: 真想不到他又犯了完全相同的错误。

sentences.sentence: a woman of extraordinary beauty
sentences.translation: 容貌出众的女子

sentences.sentence: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
sentences.translation: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

sentences.sentence: Their lack of qualifications condemned them to a lifetime of boring, usually poorly-paid work.
sentences.translation: 他们资历的缺乏迫使他们要一辈子做单调乏味且通常报酬很低的工作。

sentences.sentence: The gutters were blocked and overflowing.
sentences.translation: 排水沟堵住了，水都溢出来了。

sentences.sentence: Instead of ending up in jail or in the gutter he was remarkably successful.
sentences.translation: 他最后不但没有坐牢或流落贫民窟，反而还非常成功。

sentences.sentence: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
sentences.translation: 刹车似乎不正常。

sentences.sentence: Then he’s not doing his job properly.
sentences.translation: 那么他没把分内事做好。

sentences.sentence: Parents should teach their children to behave properly in public.
sentences.translation: 家长应该教导子女在公共场合要有规有矩。

sentences.sentence: properly trained staff
sentences.translation: 训练有素的员工

sentences.sentence: He passed himself off as a senior psychologist.
sentences.translation: 他自己冒充是一名资深心理学家。

sentences.sentence: I've tried to pass off my accent as a New York one.
sentences.translation: 我试图把我的口音冒充为纽约口音。

sentences.sentence: the Duchess of York
sentences.translation: 约克公爵夫人

sentences.sentence: ...the German ambassador to Poland.
sentences.translation: …德国驻波兰大使。

phrases.translation: 相识不深的人；不完整或肤浅的知识

sentences.sentence: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
sentences.translation: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

sentences.sentence: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
sentences.translation: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

sentences.sentence: I should be delighted to make Mrs McGough’s acquaintance.
sentences.translation: 我很高兴能认识麦高夫太太。

sentences.sentence: The practice of a lawyer requires acquaintance with court procedures.
sentences.translation: 当律师要熟悉法庭程序。

sentences.sentence: I should be delighted to make Mrs McGough’s acquaintance.
sentences.translation: 我很高兴能认识麦高夫太太。

phrases.translation: 少数的人；少量的几个人

sentences.sentence: The boy picked up a handful of stones and started throwing them at us.
sentences.translation: 那男孩捡起一把石子，开始朝我们扔过来。

sentences.sentence: He surveyed the handful of customers at the bar.
sentences.translation: 他打量着吧台边仅有的几位顾客。

sentences.sentence: I stared at her in amazement.
sentences.translation: 我惊讶地盯着她。

sentences.sentence: They reacted with sighs of disappointment and stared in amazement at Hanna, who had more or less won the exchange.
sentences.translation: 他们都发出了失望的叹息，惊讶地盯着汉娜，她或多或少赢得了些理解。

phrases.translation: 寻找发迹的机会；寻出路
花大价钱；价格很高；值一大笔钱

sentences.sentence: He made a fortune selling property in Spain.
sentences.translation: 他在西班牙卖房产，发了大财。

sentences.sentence: My first painting sold for £25, a small fortune then for an art student.
sentences.translation: 我的第一幅画卖了25英镑，这在当时对一个学艺术的学生来说是一大笔钱。

sentences.sentence: He died in poverty in 1947, but his art is worth a fortune .
sentences.translation: 1947年他在贫困中死去，但是现在他的美术作品值大钱了。

sentences.sentence: The carpet must have cost a fortune .
sentences.translation: 这块地毯肯定花了不少钱吧。

sentences.sentence: It is quite easy to decorate your house without spending a fortune .
sentences.translation: 不花大钱装修房子也是很容易的。

sentences.sentence: Her personal fortune was estimated at £37 million.
sentences.translation: 她的个人财产估计有3,700万英镑。

sentences.sentence: I had the good fortune to work with a brilliant head of department.
sentences.translation: 我有幸与一位出色的部门主管共事。

translations.translation: 真实的；真正的；可信的； 可靠的

sentences.sentence: an authentic account
sentences.translation: 真实可信的说法

sentences.sentence: Sure, I saw him but, generally speaking, drunks falling over are not my problem. Next time I see one I will do the same.
sentences.translation: 我答道：“当然，我看见了他，但是一般而言，醉汉摔倒并不关我的事，下次遇到同样的事情我还是会像今天这么做的。”

sentences.sentence: These documents have no legal status in Britain.
sentences.translation: 这些文件在英国并无法律效力。

sentences.sentence: What is your marital status (= are you married or not ) ?
sentences.translation: 你的婚姻状况是什么？

translations.translation: 更好的；职位[级别]更高的；上级的

sentences.sentence: Fletcher’s superior technique brought him victory.
sentences.translation: 弗莱彻更胜一筹的技术使他取得了胜利。

sentences.sentence: Don’t you usually salute a superior officer ?
sentences.translation: 你难道平时不向上级军官敬礼的吗？

sentences.sentence: He had a good working relationship with his immediate superior (= the person directly above him ) .
sentences.translation: 他和他的顶头上司工作关系很融洽。

sentences.sentence: Our goods compete in terms of product quality, reliability and above all variety.
sentences.translation: 我们的产品从质量、可靠性、尤其是多样性来看很有竞争力。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 137 单元

betray
音标：英 /bɪ'treɪ/  美 /bɪ'tre/
v. 显露出（本来面目）；背叛
短语：betray oneself — 原形毕露
例句：He felt that she had betrayed him.
他感觉她背叛了自己。
例句：She had betrayed her parents' trust .
她辜负了父母对她的信任。
例句：I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
我永远不会泄露秘密。

upper
音标：英 /'ʌpə/  美 /'ʌpɚ/
adj. （位置或地位）较高的；级别较高的
短语：upper part — 上部
短语：upper limit — 上限；最高极限
短语：upper bound — 上界；最大值
短语：upper hand — n. 优势，上风
短语：upper end — 上端
短语：upper lip — 上嘴唇
短语：upper layer — 上层
短语：upper class — 上等阶层，上流社会
短语：upper level — 高层；高等级；上水平
短语：upper mantle — 上地幔；上部地函
短语：upper respiratory tract — 上呼吸道
短语：upper arm — 上臂
短语：upper surface — 上表面
短语：upper right — 右上方/角
短语：upper leather — 面革
短语：upper side — 上面；上盘
短语：upper cover — 上盖，上层覆盖
短语：upper atmosphere — 上层大气；高空大气
短语：upper house — 上议院
短语：upper limb — 上肢；上翼；上边缘
例句：the upper lip
上唇

extraordinary
音标：英 /ɪkˈstrɔ:dnrɪ/  美 /ɪkˈstrɔrdənerɪ; ɪkˈstrɔrdnˌɛrɪ/
adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的
短语：extraordinary general meeting — 特别会员大会；非常股东大会
例句：It took an extraordinary amount of work.
这费了相当多的功夫。
例句：It’s extraordinary that he should make exactly the same mistake again.
真想不到他又犯了完全相同的错误。
例句：a woman of extraordinary beauty
容貌出众的女子

condemn
音标：英 /kən'dem/  美 /kən'dɛm/
v. 谴责；使……注定
例句：Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。
例句：Their lack of qualifications condemned them to a lifetime of boring, usually poorly-paid work.
他们资历的缺乏迫使他们要一辈子做单调乏味且通常报酬很低的工作。

gutter
音标：英 /'gʌtə/  美 /'gʌtɚ/
n. 排水沟；阴沟；贫民区
短语：in the gutter — [美国俚语]
例句：The gutters were blocked and overflowing.
排水沟堵住了，水都溢出来了。
例句：Instead of ending up in jail or in the gutter he was remarkably successful.
他最后不但没有坐牢或流落贫民窟，反而还非常成功。

properly
音标：英 /'prɒp(ə)lɪ/  美 /'prɑpɚli/
adv. 适当地；恰当地
短语：behave properly — 行为正当
例句：The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
刹车似乎不正常。
例句：Then he’s not doing his job properly.
那么他没把分内事做好。
例句：Parents should teach their children to behave properly in public.
家长应该教导子女在公共场合要有规有矩。
例句：properly trained staff
训练有素的员工

pass…off as…
（把某人）改变或冒充成……
例句：He passed himself off as a senior psychologist.
他自己冒充是一名资深心理学家。
例句：I've tried to pass off my accent as a New York one.
我试图把我的口音冒充为纽约口音。

duchess
音标：英 /'dʌtʃɪs; -es/  美 /'dʌtʃəs/
n. 公爵夫人；女公爵
例句：the Duchess of York
约克公爵夫人

ambassador
音标：英 /æm'bæsədə/  美 /æm'bæsədɚ/
n. 大使；使节
短语：an ambassador — 大使
短语：goodwill ambassador — 亲善大使，友好大使
短语：image ambassador — 形象大使；商品代言人
例句：...the German ambassador to Poland.
…德国驻波兰大使。

acquaintance
音标：英 /ə'kweɪnt(ə)ns/  美 /ə'kwentəns/
n. 熟人；相识；了解
短语：acquaintance with — 相识
短语：acquaintance with someone — 对某人的相识，熟
短语：nodding acquaintance — 相识不深的人；不完整或肤浅的知识
短语：make the acquaintance of — vt. 和…相识，结识
例句：She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。
例句：He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。
例句：I should be delighted to make Mrs McGough’s acquaintance.
我很高兴能认识麦高夫太太。
例句：The practice of a lawyer requires acquaintance with court procedures.
当律师要熟悉法庭程序。

make one’s acquaintance
结识；与……相见
例句：I should be delighted to make Mrs McGough’s acquaintance.
我很高兴能认识麦高夫太太。

handful
音标：英 /'hæn(d)fʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'hænd,fʊl/
n. 一把；几个人
短语：a handful of — 一把；少量的；一小部分
短语：a handful of people — 少数的人；少量的几个人
例句：The boy picked up a handful of stones and started throwing them at us.
那男孩捡起一把石子，开始朝我们扔过来。
例句：He surveyed the handful of customers at the bar.
他打量着吧台边仅有的几位顾客。

amazement
音标：英 /ə'meɪzm(ə)nt/  美 /ə'mezmənt/
n. 惊讶；惊愕
短语：in amazement — 惊讶地，吃惊地
例句：I stared at her in amazement.
我惊讶地盯着她。

in amazement
震惊；惊讶
例句：They reacted with sighs of disappointment and stared in amazement at Hanna, who had more or less won the exchange.
他们都发出了失望的叹息，惊讶地盯着汉娜，她或多或少赢得了些理解。

fortune
音标：英 /'fɔːtʃuːn; -tʃ(ə)n/  美 /'fɔrtʃən/
n. 大笔的钱；机会；运气
短语：good fortune — 好财运，好运；顺景
短语：make a fortune — 发财，赚大钱
短语：a small fortune — [口，谑]一笔巨款；很多钱
短语：fame and fortune — 名声与财富
短语：fortune magazine — 财富杂志
短语：make one's fortune — ◎发财
短语：fortune teller — 算命先生；预言家
短语：wheel of fortune — 幸运轮，轮盘赌
短语：by good fortune — 幸而
短语：fortune cookie — 签饼；福饼
短语：seek one's fortune — 寻找发迹的机会；寻出路
短语：reversal of fortune — 命运的逆转
短语：cost a fortune — 花大价钱；价格很高；值一大笔钱
例句：He made a fortune selling property in Spain.
他在西班牙卖房产，发了大财。
例句：My first painting sold for £25, a small fortune then for an art student.
我的第一幅画卖了25英镑，这在当时对一个学艺术的学生来说是一大笔钱。
例句：He died in poverty in 1947, but his art is worth a fortune .
1947年他在贫困中死去，但是现在他的美术作品值大钱了。
例句：The carpet must have cost a fortune .
这块地毯肯定花了不少钱吧。
例句：It is quite easy to decorate your house without spending a fortune .
不花大钱装修房子也是很容易的。
例句：Her personal fortune was estimated at £37 million.
她的个人财产估计有3,700万英镑。
例句：I had the good fortune to work with a brilliant head of department.
我有幸与一位出色的部门主管共事。

authentic
音标：英 /ɔː'θentɪk/  美 /ɔ'θɛntɪk/
adj. 真实的；真正的；可信的； 可靠的
例句：an authentic account
真实可信的说法

generally speaking
一般来说
例句：Sure, I saw him but, generally speaking, drunks falling over are not my problem. Next time I see one I will do the same.
我答道：“当然，我看见了他，但是一般而言，醉汉摔倒并不关我的事，下次遇到同样的事情我还是会像今天这么做的。”

status
音标：英 /'steɪtəs/  美 /ˈstetəs/
n. 身份；地位；职位
短语：status quo — n. 现状
短语：current status — 当前状态；目前状况
短语：present status — 现状
短语：social status — 社会地位
短语：legal status — 法律地位
短语：health status — 健康状态，健康状况
短语：production status — 生产情况
短语：status in quo — n. 现状
短语：marital status — 婚姻状况
短语：status bar — 状态栏
短语：economic status — 经济地位；经济状态
短语：running status — 运行情况，运行状态
短语：nutritional status — 营养状况
短语：financial status — 财务状况；财政情形
短语：status of development — 发展现状；发展状况
短语：status information — 状态信息
短语：system status — 系统状态，系统状况
短语：operating status — 经营状况；操作状态
短语：delivery status — 投送状态
短语：political status — 政治地位
例句：These documents have no legal status in Britain.
这些文件在英国并无法律效力。
例句：What is your marital status (= are you married or not ) ?
你的婚姻状况是什么？

superior
音标：英 /suːˈpɪərɪə/  美 /sʊˈpɪrɪɚ/
adj. 更好的；职位[级别]更高的；上级的
n. 上级；长官
短语：superior quality — 优质，上等品；高级货品
短语：superior performance — 性能优越
短语：superior in — 在…方面优越
短语：superior court — 高等法院；上级法院
短语：superior vena cava — 上腔靜脈
短语：superior to others — 高人一等；优于其他
短语：superior goods — 优等物品
短语：superior mesenteric artery — 肠系膜上动脉
短语：immediate superior — 直接上级
短语：superior officer — 上司；上级官员
短语：lake superior — 苏必略湖
短语：superior room — 精致客房；高级客房
短语：mother superior — 女修道院院长
短语：superior limit — 上限
短语：superior education — 超前教育
短语：superior colliculus — 上丘
短语：superior rectus — 上直肌
例句：Fletcher’s superior technique brought him victory.
弗莱彻更胜一筹的技术使他取得了胜利。
例句：Don’t you usually salute a superior officer ?
你难道平时不向上级军官敬礼的吗？
例句：He had a good working relationship with his immediate superior (= the person directly above him ) .
他和他的顶头上司工作关系很融洽。

in terms of…
就……来说；从……角度
例句：Our goods compete in terms of product quality, reliability and above all variety.
我们的产品从质量、可靠性、尤其是多样性来看很有竞争力。
